section_title: Configure the asset, strategy, and horizon the engine should read
section_intro: The homepage does not invent a winner. It shows where cost tends to concentrate for the selected combination before the full ranking runs.
strategy_hint: Available strategies change according to asset and horizon.
strategy_note_momentum: A directional strategy where execution speed and spread matter more than anything else.
strategy_note_breakout: A strategy sensitive to slippage and entry timing. Every point of friction compounds.
strategy_note_mean_reversion: A strategy that requires precise execution and contained holding costs.
strategy_note_trend: A strategy where overnight funding and rollover impact the final result.
strategy_note_news: A high-frequency strategy where spread and slippage completely dominate the edge.
capital_hint: Capital shifts the balance between percentage drag, recurring cost, and ticket cost.
score_note: Pre-ranking synthetic signal for the selected combination.
insight_scalping: In scalping, cost concentrates almost entirely in execution: spread and slippage decide everything.
insight_intraday: In intraday trading, cost concentrates in execution because every point of friction repeats many times.
insight_swing: In swing trading, the clean separation disappears and execution starts to combine with carry.
read_asset_forex: Forex asset: spread, financing, and trading session radically change the profile.
read_asset_indices: Index asset: execution quality and funding matter more than most people expect.
read_asset_crypto: Crypto asset: market structure and funding influence results more than the setup.
read_asset_us_equities: US equities: margin and holding costs matter as much as stock selection.
read_asset_it_equities: IT equities: local liquidity and cost structure change the efficiency profile.
read_asset_commodities: Commodities: rollover and contract structure weigh on net results.
read_horizon_scalping: Scalping: the engine prioritizes almost exclusively execution friction and slippage.
read_horizon_intraday: Short holding window: the engine prioritizes execution drag and turnover.
read_horizon_swing: Intermediate holding window: execution and carry begin to stack together.
read_strategy_momentum: Momentum strategy: every out-of-line spread compounds quickly.
read_strategy_breakout: Breakout: slippage and entry timing amplify every execution mistake.
read_strategy_mean_reversion: Mean reversion: even small frictions can alter the expected average edge.
read_strategy_trend: Trend: holding cost can matter as much as the setup itself.
read_strategy_news: News trading: execution quality and spread decide efficiency immediately.
read_capital_small: Compact capital: fixed and recurring costs can distort the profile heavily.
read_capital_mid: Mid-size capital: it is worth comparing structure by instrument and broker.
read_capital_large: Large capital: percentage drag becomes more visible than the ticket.
read_leverage_unlevered: 1x leverage: the profile stays close to the direct instrument.
read_leverage_light: Moderate leverage: funding and wrapper choice start to matter.
read_leverage_high: High leverage: holding cost can dominate the final ranking.
preview_note: Qualitative indicator based on the selected combination. Full TradeScope applies broker tariffs and returns the final ranking.
